assumptions_made: Assumption 1: Defaulted to /api/heavy endpoint as it is known to be concurrency-sensitive.
Assumption 2: Defaulted to POST method as it is commonly used for heavy endpoints.
Assumption 3: Defaulted to 200 virtual users as it is a common starting point for stress testing.
Assumption 4: Defaulted to 12 seconds duration as it is a common duration for stress testing.
Assumption 5: Defaulted to 200ms p95, 10% max error rate, and 500ms p99 as common success criteria for stress testing.
summary_description: Stress test the heavy endpoint with 200 users for 12 seconds to find the breaking point.
